Beyond your outfit, the only essentials are basic sun safety practices!
To get the most out of your Cabana Life piece, rinse it with fresh water after swimming and lay it flat to dry in the shade. Applying daily broad-spectrum sunscreen to any exposed skin (like your face and hands) completes your sun-safe routine.
